"""Read-only capability inspection and separate CDC integration-kit export.

This is not Ground admission, a native build executor, or firmware acceptance.
No project flag, part string or textual match can grant those authorities.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from copy import deepcopy
from enum import Enum
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re

from silverstar_fccg.core.workspace import WorkspacePolicy
from silverstar_fccg.generator.usb_cdc_transport import UsbCdcTransport_Render
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.cubemx import CubeMxImportError
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.usb_transport_capabilities import UsbCapabilities_Inspect, UsbNativeConfiguration_Describe


class UsbTransportPlanResult(str, Enum):
    Experimental = "Experimental"
    Rejected = "Rejected"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class UsbTransportPlan:
    result: UsbTransportPlanResult
    stack: str
    part: str
    indexed: bool
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]
    files_sha256: dict[str, str]
    owners: dict[str, str]
    licenses: tuple[str, ...]
    review: tuple[str, ...]
    capabilities: dict


_REVIEW = (
    "Clock/PHY/VBUS/IRQ/linker correctness: NOT PROVEN",
    "Explicit successful configure/retire/RX hooks: NOT PROVEN",
    "Native LL error propagation and physical cancellation: NOT PROVEN",
    "Complete critical contracts, stack/WCET and hardware: NOT PROVEN",
    "One main owner plus USB IRQ; no RTOS/DMA/cache/composite supported",
)
_IGNORED = {".git", "build", "debug", "release", ".idea", ".vscode"}


def _Project_Read(root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    if root.is_symlink() or root.is_junction() or not root.is_dir():
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB input must be a real project directory")
    # Resolve redirected user folders once; files below the selected source root
    # must still be regular, unaliased files. This input is always read-only.
    root = root.resolve()
    policy = WorkspacePolicy(root)
    files = {}
    total = 0
    visited = 0
    for directory, directories, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        directories[:] = [name for name in directories if name.casefold() not in _IGNORED]
        for name in directories + names:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            relative = path.relative_to(root)
            visited += 1
            if visited > 16000:
                raise CubeMxImportError("USB inspection exceeds 16000 entries")
            policy.Path_Resolve(path, allow_root=False)
            if path.is_symlink() or path.is_junction():
                raise CubeMxImportError("USB source aliases are not supported")
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            if ("license" not in name.casefold() and "release_notes" not in name.casefold() and
                    path.suffix.casefold() not in {".ioc", ".c", ".h", ".s", ".ld", ".txt", ".cmake", ".md"}
                    and path.name not in {"Makefile", "LICENSE", "COPYING", "scg-usb-build.json"}):
                continue
            remaining = 64 * 1024 * 1024 - total
            if path.stat().st_size > remaining:
                raise CubeMxImportError("USB source inspection exceeds 64 MiB")
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                body = stream.read(remaining + 1)
            if len(body) > remaining:
                raise CubeMxImportError("USB source grew beyond the inspection bound")
            total += len(body)
            files[relative.as_posix()] = body
    return files


def _Code_Read(body: bytes) -> str:
    text = body.decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
    return re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n]*", "", text, flags=re.S)


def UsbTransport_Plan(input_path: str | Path) -> UsbTransportPlan:
    root = Path(input_path).absolute()
    files = _Project_Read(root)
    hashes = {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in sorted(files.items())}
    iocs = [p for p in files if "/" not in p and p.endswith(".ioc")]
    reasons = []
    owners = {}
    if len(iocs) != 1:
        reasons.append("ONE_ROOT_IOC_REQUIRED")
    ioc = files[iocs[0]].decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace") if len(iocs) == 1 else ""
    values = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in ioc.splitlines() if "=" in line)
    part = values.get("Mcu.CPN", values.get("Mcu.Name", "UNKNOWN"))
    code = {p: _Code_Read(b) for p, b in files.items() if p.endswith((".c", ".h"))}
    native = "\n".join(code.values())
    application = "\n".join(body for p, body in code.items() if p.endswith(".c") and
        not any(part.casefold() in {"drivers", "middlewares"} for part in Path(p).parts))
    usbx = ("USBX" in ioc.upper() or any("ux_device" in p.lower() or
            "usbx" in p.lower() for p in files))
    required = ("usbd_cdc.c", "usbd_cdc.h", "usbd_def.h", "usbd_core.c", "usbd_core.h",
                "usbd_ctlreq.c", "usbd_ctlreq.h", "usbd_ioreq.c", "usbd_ioreq.h", "usbd_desc.c", "usbd_desc.h",
                "usbd_cdc_if.c", "usbd_cdc_if.h", "usb_device.c", "usb_device.h",
                "usbd_conf.c", "usbd_conf.h", "main.c", "main.h")
    for name in required:
        candidates = [p for p in files if Path(p).name == name]
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            reasons.append("MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS_OWNER:" + name)
        else:
            owners[name] = candidates[0]
    stack = "USBX" if usbx else ("ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC" if "usbd_cdc.c" in owners else
        ("PCD_ONLY" if "HAL_PCD_Init" in native else "UNKNOWN"))
    if usbx:
        reasons.append("USBX_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_ADAPTER")
    elif stack != "ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC":
        reasons.append("COMPLETE_NATIVE_CDC_REQUIRED")
    if not re.search(r"USB_DEVICE\.[^=]*Class[^=]*=Cdc\b", ioc, re.I):
        reasons.append("IOC_SINGLE_CDC_CLASS_REQUIRED")
    if (re.search(r"=USB_OTG_HS\b|=HIGH_SPEED\b|=USBX\b", ioc, re.I) or
            "hUsbDeviceHS" in code.get(owners.get("usb_device.c", ""), "")):
        reasons.append("HIGH_SPEED_OR_ALTERNATE_STACK_UNSUPPORTED")
    if re.search(r"COMPOSITE|=FREERTOS\b|=THREADX\b", ioc, re.I):
        reasons.append("COMPOSITE_OR_RTOS_OWNER_UNSUPPORTED")
    if re.search(r"dma_enable\s*=\s*(?:ENABLE|1)|SCB_EnableDCache\s*\(", application):
        reasons.append("DMA_OR_DATA_CACHE_UNSUPPORTED")
    app = code.get(owners.get("usb_device.c", ""), "")
    interface = code.get(owners.get("usbd_cdc_if.c", ""), "")
    definition = code.get(owners.get("usbd_def.h", ""), "")
    indexed = "pClassDataCmsit" in definition
    if not all(token in app for token in ("hUsbDeviceFS", "MX_USB_DEVICE_Init", "USBD_RegisterClass")):
        reasons.append("SINGLE_FS_INIT_OWNER_REQUIRED")
    if (len(re.findall(r"USBD_RegisterClass\s*\(", app)) != 1 or
            "USBD_RegisterClassComposite" in app):
        reasons.append("SINGLE_CLASS_REQUIRED")
    if not all(token in interface for token in ("CDC_Transmit_FS", "CDC_Receive_FS", "USBD_CDC_ReceivePacket")):
        reasons.append("CLASSIC_FS_INTERFACE_ABI_REQUIRED")
    if (not indexed and "pClassData" not in definition) or "TxState" not in native:
        reasons.append("CLASS_STORAGE_ABI_UNRECOGNIZED")
    if "HAL_PCD_IRQHandler" not in application or not any(p.lower().endswith(".s") for p in files):
        reasons.append("NATIVE_IRQ_AND_STARTUP_REQUIRED")
    if not any(p.endswith(".ld") for p in files):
        reasons.append("NATIVE_LINKER_REQUIRED")
    if not any(Path(p).name in {"Makefile", "CMakeLists.txt", "scg-usb-build.json"} for p in files):
        reasons.append("NATIVE_BUILD_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED")
    if "SystemClock_Config" not in native:
        reasons.append("NATIVE_CLOCK_OWNER_REQUIRED")
    licenses = tuple(sorted(p for p in files if "license" in Path(p).name.lower() or
                            Path(p).name == "COPYING"))
    capabilities, capability_reasons = UsbCapabilities_Inspect(files, owners)
    reasons.extend(capability_reasons)
    capabilities["layers"] = {
        "stack": stack, "class_abi": ("indexed" if indexed else "legacy") if stack == "ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC" else "NOT_CLASSIC",
        "link": "FS_SINGLE_CDC" if stack == "ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC" and
            "HIGH_SPEED_OR_ALTERNATE_STACK_UNSUPPORTED" not in reasons else "UNSUPPORTED_OR_UNRESOLVED",
        "scheduler": "UNSUPPORTED_OR_UNRESOLVED" if usbx or
            "COMPOSITE_OR_RTOS_OWNER_UNSUPPORTED" in reasons else "MAIN_PLUS_USB_IRQ_ONLY",
        "buffer_owner": "CPU_STATIC_COPY_ADAPTER" if stack == "ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC" and
            "DMA_OR_DATA_CACHE_UNSUPPORTED" not in reasons else "UNSUPPORTED_OR_UNRESOLVED",
        "unsupported": ["USBX_STANDALONE_ADAPTER", "USBX_THREADX_ADAPTER", "HS",
                        "DMA", "DATA_CACHE", "COMPOSITE", "CLASSIC_RTOS"],
        "native_configuration_owner": "CUBEMX_INPUT",
        "adapter_eligibility": "BLOCKED" if reasons else "SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY",
    }
    capabilities["native_configuration"] = UsbNativeConfiguration_Describe(files, owners)
    capabilities["configuration_findings"] = capabilities["native_configuration"]["findings"]
    if not reasons:
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.usb_cdc_integration import UsbIntegrationProfile_Get
        try:
            profile = UsbIntegrationProfile_Get(files)
            capabilities["automatic_integration"] = {"status": "SOURCE_SHAPE_AVAILABLE", "profile": profile}
        except ValueError as error:
            capabilities["automatic_integration"] = {"status": "MANUAL_HOOKS_REQUIRED", "reason": str(error)}
    else:
        capabilities["automatic_integration"] = {"status": "BLOCKED_BY_CAPABILITY_FINDINGS"}
    return UsbTransportPlan(UsbTransportPlanResult.Rejected if reasons else
        UsbTransportPlanResult.Experimental, stack, part, indexed,
        tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons)), hashes, owners, licenses, _REVIEW, capabilities)


def UsbAdaptation_Describe(plan: UsbTransportPlan, *, integrated: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Local import/audit description, never an assertion of runtime readiness.

    This does not create a second contracts/ authority or authorize arbitrary
    patch instructions. Source replacement remains generator-owned and bounded.
    """
    classic = plan.stack == "ST_USB_DEVICE_CDC"
    from silverstar_fccg.hardware.usb_transport_profiles import CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS
    controller = plan.capabilities['automatic_integration'].get('profile', {}).get('controller_contract')
    return {
        "format": "silverstar.usb.adaptation", "version": 1,
        "readiness": "BLOCKED" if plan.reasons else "EXPERIMENTAL_UNVERIFIED",
        "native_sources_sha256": plan.files_sha256, "native_owners": plan.owners,
        "capability_layers": plan.capabilities["layers"],
        "native_build_inventory": plan.capabilities.get("build", {}),
        "native_configuration": plan.capabilities["native_configuration"],
        "controller_contract": deepcopy(CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS.get(controller)),
        "native_authority": ["clock", "pins", "PCD initialization", "USB initialization",
                             "PMA/FIFO layout", "startup", "linker", "IRQ wiring"],
        "bindings": {"status": "PROPOSED_CLASSIC_FS" if classic else "UNBOUND_UNSUPPORTED_STACK",
                     "device": "hUsbDeviceFS" if classic else None,
                     "initialize": "MX_USB_DEVICE_Init" if classic else None,
                     "receive": "CDC_Receive_FS" if classic else None,
                     "transmit": "CDC_Transmit_FS" if classic else None,
                     "class_data": ("pClassDataCmsit[0]" if plan.indexed else "pClassData") if classic else None},
        "transport": {"rx_capacity": 512, "tx_capacity": 256, "packet_size": 64,
                      "applicability": "PROPOSED_CLASSIC_FS_ADAPTER_ONLY",
                      "queue_success_is_delivery_ack": False},
        "lifecycle_hooks": {name: "GENERATED_NOT_ACCEPTED" if integrated else "UNBOUND_REQUIRES_REVIEW"
            for name in ("configure_after_native_success", "receive_copy_and_deferred_rearm", "single_main_service",
                         "invalidate_on_reset_disconnect_suspend_fault", "retire_only_after_checked_cancellation")},
        "build_attachment": {"source_replacements": "lifecycle-integration.json" if integrated else None,
            "additional_sources": ["Src/usb_cdc_transport.c", "Src/usb_cdc_port.c"] +
                (["Src/usb_cdc_retire.c"] if integrated else []),
            "assertion_owner": "CHOOSE_BUNDLED_OR_EXISTING_EXACTLY_ONCE"},
        "automatic_integration": plan.capabilities["automatic_integration"],
        "missing_capabilities": list(plan.reasons),
        "configuration_findings": plan.capabilities["configuration_findings"],
        "required_evidence": ["effective compiler dependencies and ABI", "unique source replacement graph",
            "normal and fault Host cases", "ARM link and analyzer", "critical-contract review",
            "controller cancellation and IRQ timing on board", "complete stack bounds"],
        "acceptance": "NOT_PROVEN",
    }


def _AssertionFiles_Read() -> dict[str, bytes]:
    scg = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    payload = scg / "plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload"
    paths = ("Common/Inc/silverstar_assert.h", "Common/Inc/silverstar_compiler.h",
             "Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c")
    return {**{p: (payload / p).read_bytes() for p in paths},
            "LICENSE-SilverStar.txt": (scg.parents[1] / "LICENSE").read_bytes()}


def UsbTransport_Export(input_path: str | Path, output_path: str | Path, *, integrate: bool = False) -> UsbTransportPlan:
    root = Path(input_path).absolute()
    output = Path(output_path).absolute()
    if any(p.is_symlink() or p.is_junction() for p in (output, *output.parents)):
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB kit output aliases are not supported")
    plan = UsbTransport_Plan(root)
    if plan.result != UsbTransportPlanResult.Experimental:
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB integration rejected: " + "; ".join(plan.reasons))
    integrated = {}
    if integrate:
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.usb_cdc_integration import UsbCdcIntegration_Render
        native = _Project_Read(root)
        if {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in native.items()} != plan.files_sha256:
            raise CubeMxImportError("Native USB input changed before integration")
        try:
            integrated = UsbCdcIntegration_Render(native, plan.owners)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise CubeMxImportError(str(error)) from error
    if output.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or root.resolve().is_relative_to(output.resolve()):
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB kit output must be disjoint from the input")
    policy = WorkspacePolicy(output.parent)
    destination = policy.Path_Resolve(output, allow_root=False)
    if destination.exists():
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB kit output must not already exist")
    if (output.parent / ".staging").is_symlink() or (output.parent / ".staging").is_junction():
        raise CubeMxImportError("USB kit staging aliases are not supported")
    stage = policy.StagingDirectory_Create("usb-kit-")
    try:
        rendered = UsbCdcTransport_Render(indexed=plan.indexed)
        rendered.update(integrated)
        assertion_files = _AssertionFiles_Read()
        rendered.update(assertion_files)
        rendered["assertion-owner.json"] = json.dumps({
            "owner": "apps/SCG/plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload",
            "license": "repository LICENSE (Apache-2.0); native input licenses remain independent",
            "files_sha256": {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in assertion_files.items()},
        }, indent=2).encode()
        rendered["integration.json"] = json.dumps(asdict(plan), indent=2).encode()
        rendered["usb-adaptation.json"] = json.dumps(UsbAdaptation_Describe(plan, integrated=integrate), indent=2).encode()
        rendered["README.txt"] = (
            "Experimental integration kit, not a ready firmware. Native project unchanged.\n"
            "See apps/SCG/docs/USB_CDC_TRANSPORT_20261013.md for all hook contracts.\n"
            "Includes the unchanged SilverStar fail-stop owner and its Apache-2.0 license.\n"
            "Call Configure only after real configuration success. Native Init owns first RX arm.\n"
            "CDC Receive: call UsbCdc_Receive exactly once; remove native immediate rearm.\n"
            "Main owner: call UsbCdc_Service regularly and check every result.\n"
            "Reset/disconnect/unconfigure/suspend/fault: LinkDown before application publication.\n"
            "Quiesced only after successful hardware cancellation; never from timeout/state alone.\n"
            "Then Configure on a new successful configuration. All TX writers must use this kit.\n"
            "USBD_OK can hide discarded LL failures; middleware acceptance remains NOT PROVEN.\n"
            "CMake >= 3.17: include usb_cdc_transport.cmake; UsbCdc_Attach(target BUNDLED).\n"
            "For an existing compatible SilverStar assertion owner use EXISTING instead.\n"
            "Make: add both Src C files, Inc and Common/Inc; include Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c\n"
            "only when the native target does not already link that assertion owner.\n"
            "No hooks, stack source patches, clock or IRQ edits are applied automatically.\n"
        ).encode()
        if integrate:
            rendered["README.txt"] += (
                "\nOPT-IN SOURCE-BOUND INTEGRATION: lifecycle-integration.json lists exact replacements.\n"
                "Compile each Native derivative instead of its original, never both; add all additional_sources.\n"
                "CubeMX clock/PMA/FIFO/initialization/startup remain authoritative. Input project is unchanged.\n"
                "Configuration is checked before class initialization; invalid PMA/FIFO layout blocks online state.\n"
                "Do not use the plain UsbCdc_Attach fragment alone for an integrated build.\n"
                "Suspend invalidates the session; resume stays offline until reset/reconfiguration.\n"
                "This connects callbacks in source, not a hardware or full safety acceptance.\n"
            ).encode()
        for relative, body in rendered.items():
            path = stage / relative
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(body)
        if UsbTransport_Plan(root) != plan or _AssertionFiles_Read() != assertion_files:
            raise CubeMxImportError("Native USB input changed during export")
        manifest = {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in rendered.items()}
        # Reserve exclusively. Never replace even an empty directory created
        # concurrently by the user. A completion manifest is published last;
        # failures leave an identifiable incomplete kit, never delete user data.
        destination.mkdir()
        for relative, body in {**rendered, "kit-sha256.json": json.dumps(manifest, indent=2).encode()}.items():
            path = policy.Path_Resolve(destination / relative, allow_root=False)
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(body)
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            policy.Tree_Remove(stage)
    return plan


def main() -> int:
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--integrate", action="store_true",
                        help="Export source-bound native lifecycle derivatives; requires --output")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.integrate and not args.output:
        parser.error("--integrate requires --output")
    plan = UsbTransport_Export(args.input, args.output, integrate=args.integrate) if args.output else UsbTransport_Plan(args.input)
    print(json.dumps(asdict(plan), indent=2))
    return 0 if plan.result == UsbTransportPlanResult.Experimental else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Effective ARM attribute and independent vector-slot checks, separate from text ownership."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import struct


def NativeAssemblyDirectives_Validate(text: str, *, core: str, fpu: str,
                                     reviewed_assert_trap: bool = False) -> None:
    arch = {"cortex-m0": "armv6-m", "cortex-m0plus": "armv6s-m",
            "cortex-m3": "armv7-m", "cortex-m4": "armv7e-m"}[core]
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n]*|^[ \t]*@[^\r\n]*", "", text, flags=re.S | re.M)
    for kind, value in re.findall(r"(?<!\w)\.(cpu|arch|arch_extension|fpu)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+)", clean):
        value = value.lower()
        allowed = {"cpu": {core}, "arch": {arch}, "arch_extension": set(),
                   "fpu": {"softvfp", *([fpu] if fpu else [])}}[kind]
        if value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError("Native CPU directive contradicts independent device facts: ." + kind + " " + value)
    raw = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)\.inst(?:\.[nw])?\b[^\r\n]*", clean))
    if raw:
        # GCC emits the established __builtin_trap as Thumb UDF #255 (0xdeff).
        # This exact opcode is available on all admitted M profiles. Only the
        # unchanged owned assertion unit can request this check; native startup
        # and arbitrary inline assembly cannot use it to bypass ISA validation.
        trap = re.search(r"(?ms)^SilverStarAssert_Fail:\s*\n(.*?)^[ \t]*\.size\s+"
                         r"SilverStarAssert_Fail\s*,", clean)
        if (not reviewed_assert_trap or trap is None or len(raw) != 1 or
                not trap.start(1) <= raw[0].start() < trap.end(1) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\.inst\s+0xdeff\s*", raw[0][0])):
            raise ValueError("Native raw instruction encoding requires a separately reviewed instruction contract")


def NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes: str, *, core: str, fpu: str, hard_float: bool,
                                 assembly: bool = False) -> None:
    tags = dict(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(Tag_\w+):\s*([^\r\n]+)", attributes))
    arch, thumb = {"cortex-m0": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m0plus": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m3": ("v7", "Thumb-2"),
                   "cortex-m4": ("v7E-M", "Thumb-2")}[core]
    profile = tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch_profile", "Microcontroller" if core in {"cortex-m0","cortex-m0plus"} else "")
    if (tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch") != arch or tags.get("Tag_THUMB_ISA_use") != thumb or
            profile != "Microcontroller"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM architecture attributes contradict independent core facts")
    if "Tag_ARM_ISA_use" in tags or "Tag_Advanced_SIMD_arch" in tags:
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires an unsupported instruction profile")
    if "Tag_FP_arch" in tags and (fpu != "fpv4-sp-d16" or tags["Tag_FP_arch"] != "VFPv4-D16"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating attributes contradict independent FPU facts")
    if "Tag_ABI_HardFP_use" in tags and tags["Tag_ABI_HardFP_use"] != "SP only":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires unsupported floating instructions")
    arguments = tags.get("Tag_ABI_VFP_args")
    if (arguments is not None and arguments != "VFP registers") or (arguments is not None and not hard_float):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating calling ABI contradicts native contract")
    if hard_float and not assembly and arguments != "VFP registers":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM C/ELF lacks its required hard-float calling ABI")


def NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector: bytes, symbols: str, slots: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    entries = {name: (int(address, 16), kind) for address, kind, name in
               re.findall(r"(?m)^([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(\w)\s+(\w+)$", symbols)}
    if not slots:
        raise ValueError("Independent IRQn slots are missing")
    for handler, irqn in slots.items():
        if handler not in entries or entries[handler][1] != "T":
            raise ValueError("Independent IRQn has no strong compiled handler: " + handler)
        offset = (irqn + 16) * 4
        if (offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(vector) or
                struct.unpack_from("<I", vector, offset)[0] != (entries[handler][0] | 1)):
            raise ValueError("Actual vector contradicts independent IRQn binding: " + handler)

    vendor = ["-Wall", "-Werror=implicit-function-declaration", "-Werror=incompatible-pointer-types",
              "-Werror=return-type", "-Wvla", "-Werror=vla"]
    symbols_required = ["UsbCdc_Service", "UsbCdc_Configure", "UsbCdc_Quiesced", "UsbCdc_Receive",
        "UsbCdc_Read", "UsbCdc_Write", "UsbCdc_LinkDown", "UsbCdc_SessionGet", "UsbCdcRetire_Endpoint",
        "UsbCdcRetire_ConfigurationCheck"]
    if baseline:
        symbols_required = ["USBD_Init", "USBD_CDC_TransmitPacket"]
    profiles = (
        ("f103", "cortex-m3", "", {"USB_LP_CAN1_RX0_IRQHandler": 20}),
        ("f407", "cortex-m4", "fpv4-sp-d16", {"OTG_FS_IRQHandler": 67}),
    )
    receipts = []
    for part, core, fpu, slots in profiles:
        native = reference / ("cube-" + part + "-usb")
        if part == "f407" and f407_reference is not None:

        root = output / "native" / part
        if baseline:
            plan = UsbTransport_Plan(native)
            from silverstar_fccg.generator.usb_cdc_integration import UsbIntegrationProfile_Get
            profile = UsbIntegrationProfile_Get(_Project_Read(native))
            root.mkdir(parents=True)
            manifest = {"replacements": [], "additional_sources": [], "profile": profile}
        else:
            plan = UsbTransport_Export(native, root, integrate=True)
            manifest = json.loads((root / "lifecycle-integration.json").read_text())
        build = plan.capabilities["build"]
        contract = CONTROLLER_CONTRACTS[manifest['profile']['controller_contract']]
        if contract['compiler'] != {'core': core, 'fpu': fpu,
                'float_abi': 'hard' if fpu else 'soft', 'independent_irq_slots': slots}:
            raise ValueError('Controller contract differs from independent compiler/IRQ validation binding')
        flags = ["-mcpu=" + core, "-mthumb", "-mfloat-abi=" + ("hard" if fpu else "soft")]
        if fpu:
            flags += ["-mfpu=" + fpu]
        if build["cpu"] != ["-mcpu=" + core]:
            raise ValueError("reviewed compiler CPU differs from native inventory")
        replacements = {entry["original"]: entry["derived"] for entry in manifest["replacements"]}
        sources = []
        for source in build["sources"]:
            sources.append({"input": source, "compiled": str(root / replacements[source]) if source in replacements
                            else str(native / source), "policy": "vendor"})
        for source in manifest["additional_sources"]:
            dest = root / "Generated/UsbTransport" / source
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes((root / source).read_bytes())
            sources.append({"input": "Generated/UsbTransport/" + source, "compiled": str(dest), "policy": "first_party"})
        for header in (root / "Inc").glob("*.h"):
            dest = root / "Generated/UsbTransport/Inc" / header.name
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(header.read_bytes())
        if not baseline:
            sources.append({"input": "Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c",
                            "compiled": str(root / "Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c"), "policy": "first_party"})
        includes = [] if baseline else [root / "Generated/UsbTransport/Inc", root / "Common/Inc"]
        includes += [root / entry["derived"] / ".." for entry in manifest["replacements"]
                     if entry["original"].endswith(".h")]
        includes += [native / token[2:] for token in build["include_dirs"]]
        includes = [path.resolve() for path in includes]
        defines = build["defines"]
        graph = {"scope": "UNMODIFIED_NATIVE_BASELINE" if baseline else "USB_ONLY_NATIVE_CALLBACK_REPLACEMENTS_NOT_GROUND_ADMISSION",
            "sources": sources, "assembly": [str(native / p) for p in build["asm_sources"]],
            "includes": list(map(str, includes)), "defines": defines, "mcu_flags": flags,
            "linker": str(native / build["linker_script"][0]), "required_symbols": symbols_required,
            "independent_irq_slots": slots, "input_hashes": plan.files_sha256,
            "profile": manifest["profile"], "critical_contracts": "NOT_PROVEN"}
        graph['controller_contract'] = contract
        (root / "Generated").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (root / "Generated/usb_transport_source_graph.json").write_text(json.dumps(graph, indent=2))
        if len(set(entry["input"] for entry in sources)) != len(sources):
            raise ValueError("duplicate source owner")
        # Every replacement must be compiled exactly once; no original callback
        # source may remain in the graph. Native input is referenced read-only.
        for old, derived in replacements.items():
            if old.endswith(".c"):
                assert sum(entry["compiled"] == str(root / derived) for entry in sources) == 1
                assert all(entry["compiled"] != str(native / old) for entry in sources)
        receipt = {"graph_sha256": hashlib.sha256((root / "Generated/usb_transport_source_graph.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   "part": part, "builds": [], "critical_contracts": "NOT_PROVEN",
                   "stack_wcet_hardware": "NOT_PROVEN", "warning_logs": [], "linked_library_files": {},
                   "native_root": str(native), "native_configuration": plan.capabilities["native_configuration"],
                   "configuration_findings": plan.capabilities["configuration_findings"]}
        receipt['controller_contract'] = contract
        sdk_facts = {}
        for library in ("libc_nano.a", "libm.a", "libnosys.a", "libgcc.a"):
            path = Path(run(part + "-locate-" + library, ["arm-none-eabi-gcc", *flags,
                "-print-file-name=" + library], root).strip()).resolve()
            receipt["linked_library_files"][str(path)] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for mode in ("normal", "analyzer"):
            build_dir = root / "build" / mode
            build_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
            objects = []
            for index, entry in enumerate(sources):
                obj = build_dir / (str(index).zfill(2) + "-" + Path(entry["input"]).stem + ".o")
                command = ["arm-none-eabi-gcc", *flags, "-std=c11", "-Os", "-ffunction-sections",
                    "-fdata-sections", "-fstack-usage", *("-I" + str(p) for p in includes), *defines,
                    *(strict if entry["policy"] == "first_party" else vendor)]
                if mode == "analyzer":
                    command.append("-fanalyzer")
                command += ["-MD", "-MF", str(obj.with_suffix(".d")), "-c", entry["compiled"], "-o", str(obj)]
                diagnostics = run(part + "-" + mode + "-" + obj.stem, command, root)
                if re.search(r"\bwarning:", diagnostics):
                    receipt["warning_logs"].append(part + "-" + mode + "-" + obj.stem + ".log")
                objects.append(str(obj))
                if mode == "normal" and Path(entry["input"]).name.endswith(('_hal_pcd.c', '_hal_pcd_ex.c', '_ll_usb.c')):
                    selected = obj.with_suffix('.i')
                    run(part + '-preprocessed-' + obj.stem, command[:command.index('-MD')] +
                        ['-E', entry['compiled'], '-o', str(selected)], root)
                    from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeC_FunctionSpanGet
                    text = selected.read_text(encoding='utf8')
                    names = ('HAL_PCD_Init', 'HAL_PCD_EP_Open', 'HAL_PCD_EP_Close', 'HAL_PCD_EP_Abort',
                        'HAL_PCD_EP_Transmit', 'HAL_PCD_EP_Receive', 'HAL_PCD_IRQHandler',
                        'USB_EPStopXfer', 'USB_DeactivateEndpoint', 'USB_ActivateEndpoint', 'USB_EPStartXfer',
                        'USB_FlushTxFifo', 'USB_FlushRxFifo', 'HAL_PCDEx_PMAConfig',
                        'HAL_PCDEx_SetRxFiFo', 'HAL_PCDEx_SetTxFiFo')
                    for name in names:
                        try:
                            start, _opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(text, name)
                        except ValueError:
                            continue
                        sdk_facts[name] = {'source': entry['compiled'], 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(entry['compiled']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                            'effective_translation_unit': str(selected), 'preprocessed_sha256': hashlib.sha256(selected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                            'function': text[start:end], 'semantic_acceptance': 'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'}
            for index, source in enumerate(graph["assembly"]):
                obj = build_dir / ("asm-" + str(index) + ".o")
                run(part + "-" + mode + "-asm", ["arm-none-eabi-gcc", *flags, *defines,
                    "-x", "assembler-with-cpp", "-MD", "-MF", str(obj.with_suffix(".d")),
                    "-c", source, "-o", str(obj)], root)
                objects.append(str(obj))
            elf = build_dir / "usb-transport-integrated.elf"
            link = run(part + "-" + mode + "-link", ["arm-none-eabi-gcc", *objects, *flags,
                *("-Wl,-u," + name for name in symbols_required),
                "-Wl,--gc-sections,-Map=" + str(elf.with_suffix(".map")), "-T" + graph["linker"],
                "-specs=nano.specs", "-lc", "-lm", "-lnosys", "-o", str(elf)], root)
            if re.search(r"\bwarning:", link):
                receipt["warning_logs"].append(part + "-" + mode + "-link.log")
            attributes = run(part + "-" + mode + "-attributes", ["arm-none-eabi-readelf", "-A", str(elf)], root)
            NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes, core=core, fpu=fpu, hard_float=bool(fpu))
            symbols = run(part + "-" + mode + "-symbols", ["arm-none-eabi-nm", "-n", str(elf)], root)
            assert all(" " + symbol + "\n" in symbols for symbol in symbols_required)
            vector = build_dir / "vectors.bin"
            run(part + "-" + mode + "-vectors", ["arm-none-eabi-objcopy", "--dump-section", ".isr_vector=" + str(vector), str(elf)], root)
            NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector.read_bytes(), symbols, slots)
            run(part + "-" + mode + "-size", ["arm-none-eabi-size", str(elf)], root)
            # Exact input hashing covers compiler dependency content in the
            # native tree; manifests retain effective include resolution too.
            deps = "\n".join(p.read_text() for p in build_dir.glob("*.d"))
            for entry in manifest["replacements"]:
                if entry["original"].endswith(".h"):
                    effective = str(root / entry["derived"]).replace("\\", "/")
                    assert effective in deps.replace("\\", "/"), "derived configuration header missing from dependencies"
            receipt["builds"].append({"mode": mode, "elf": str(elf),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(elf.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "status": "COMPILED_LINKED_ANALYZER_EXECUTED" if mode == "analyzer" else "COMPILED_LINKED"})
        gate = SCG / "plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload/Tools/check_power_of_ten.ps1"
        (root / "Tools").mkdir()
        (root / "Tools/check_power_of_ten.ps1").write_bytes(gate.read_bytes())
        # The unchanged checker joins linker paths to its project root. Supply
        # a byte-identical projection, not a Windows absolute path that Join-Path
        # would incorrectly concatenate. Actual ARM commands retain the native
        # authoritative linker path and both hashes are checked here.
        gate_linker = "Native/" + build["linker_script"][0]
        (root / gate_linker).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (root / gate_linker).write_bytes(Path(graph["linker"]).read_bytes())
        assert hashlib.sha256((root / gate_linker).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == plan.files_sha256[build["linker_script"][0]]
        # Checker projection of the actual explicit graph. The imported Make
        # is never executed; this projection is not a runnable Ground project.
        emitted_make = _Makefile_Render(tuple(entry["compiled"] for entry in sources), tuple(graph["assembly"]),
            tuple(map(str, includes)), tuple(value[2:] for value in defines),
            SimpleNamespace(mcu_flags=flags, linker_script=gate_linker), "arm-none-eabi-")
        (root / "Tools/owning-template-Makefile.txt").write_text(emitted_make)
        (root / "Makefile").write_text("# CHECKER PROJECTION ONLY; compiled by the recorded direct commands.\n" + emitted_make)
        emitted = emitted_make.split("power10-check:\n", 1)[1].splitlines()[0].strip()
        # Include complete vendor derivatives in the review scan as well: owned
        # edits inside them must not disappear behind the third-party boundary.
        # This deliberately also exposes retained upstream violations. It is a
        # review over-approximation, not an authorization to enlarge exceptions.
        for entry in manifest["replacements"]:
            if entry["original"].endswith(".c"):
                dest = root / "Generated/UsbVendorReview" / entry["original"]
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_bytes((root / entry["derived"]).read_bytes())
        if baseline:
            for name in ("main.c", "usbd_core.c", "usbd_cdc.c", "usbd_cdc_if.c", "usbd_conf.c"):
                original = plan.owners[name]
                dest = root / "Generated/UsbVendorReview" / original
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_bytes((native / original).read_bytes())
        gate_log = run(part + "-power10", shlex.split(emitted), root, expected=None)
        receipt["power10"] = ("FAIL" if "Power of Ten check FAILED" in gate_log else
            "PASS_TEXT_ONLY" if "Power of Ten project text checks passed" in gate_log else "ERROR_SEE_LOG")
        receipt["gate_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(gate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in _Project_Read(native).items()} != plan.files_sha256:
            raise ValueError("native input changed during validation")
        receipt["input_preserved"] = True
        (root / 'sdk-function-facts.json').write_text(json.dumps(sdk_facts, indent=2), encoding='utf8')
        (root / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
        receipts.append(receipt)
    (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({"baseline": baseline, "receipts": receipts,
        "limits": "Host models plus exact integrated ARM builds only. Vendor callbacks, EP0, physical cancellation, clock/IRQ timing, stack and hardware acceptance NOT PROVEN."}, indent=2))
    return all(not row["warning_logs"] and row["power10"] == "PASS_TEXT_ONLY" for row in receipts)


def _Power10_SourceProvenance(baseline: Path, current: Path, part: str, text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Locate added/moved failing source lines; text matching is not ownership."""
    tail = text.split('Power of Ten check FAILED', 1)[-1]
    rows = []
    cache = {}
    for filename, number in re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*(?:-\s*)?([^\r\n:]+\.c):(\d+):', tail):
        relative = Path(filename.strip().replace('\\', '/'))
        if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts:
            raise ValueError('Unsafe reported checker source path')
        old, new = baseline/'native'/part/relative, current/'native'/part/relative
        line = int(number)
        if relative not in cache:
            if old.is_file() and new.is_file():
                a, b = old.read_text().splitlines(), new.read_text().splitlines()
                mapping = {j+offset+1: i+offset+1
                    for tag, i, end_i, j, end_j in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).get_opcodes()
                    if tag == 'equal' for offset in range(end_i-i)}
                cache[relative] = (mapping, b)
            else:
                cache[relative] = ({}, new.read_text().splitlines() if new.is_file() else [])
        mapping, source = cache[relative]
        rows.append({'source': str(relative), 'line': line, 'baseline_line': mapping.get(line),
            'text': source[line-1] if 0 < line <= len(source) else None,
            'classification': 'VERBATIM_BASELINE_LINE' if line in mapping else 'ADDED_OR_MOVED_REQUIRES_REVIEW',
            'semantic_contracts': 'NOT_PROVEN_BY_LINE_MAPPING'})
    return rows


def UsbEvidence_Compare(baseline: Path, current: Path):
    """Attribute unchanged diagnostics; never convert the failed gate to PASS."""
    previous = json.loads((baseline / 'summary.json').read_text())
    actual = json.loads((current / 'summary.json').read_text())
    if not previous.get('baseline') or actual.get('baseline'):
        raise ValueError('comparison requires an unchanged native baseline and an integrated run')
    rows = []
    def failures(text):
        if 'Power of Ten check FAILED' not in text:
            if 'Power of Ten project text checks passed' in text:
                return []
            raise ValueError('Gate output has no recognized completion status')
        tail = text.split('Power of Ten check FAILED', 1)[1]
        lines = [line.strip() for line in tail.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()]
        return [re.sub(r'has \d+ non-comment code lines', 'has LENGTH non-comment code lines',
            re.sub(r':\d+:', ':LINE:', line)) for line in lines]
    for now, before in zip(actual['receipts'], previous['receipts'], strict=True):
        assert now['part'] == before['part']
        part = now['part']
        a = json.loads((current/'native'/part/'Generated/usb_transport_source_graph.json').read_text())
        b = json.loads((baseline/'native'/part/'Generated/usb_transport_source_graph.json').read_text())
        assert a['input_hashes'] == b['input_hashes'], 'baseline input revision differs'
        warning_rows = []
        for label in now['warning_logs']:
            prior = baseline / label
            identical = prior.is_file() and prior.read_bytes() == (current/label).read_bytes()
            warning_rows.append({'log': label, 'unchanged_native_baseline_identical': identical,
                'classification': 'EXISTING_VENDOR_DIAGNOSTIC' if identical else 'NEW_OR_CHANGED_REQUIRES_REVIEW'})
        old_text = (baseline/(part+'-power10.log')).read_text()
        new_text = (current/(part+'-power10.log')).read_text()
        old_failures = failures(old_text)
        new_failures = failures(new_text)
        def lengths(text):
            return {name: int(count) for name, count in re.findall(
                r'function (\w+) has (\d+) non-comment code lines', text)}
        old_lengths, new_lengths = lengths(old_text), lengths(new_text)
        old_count, new_count = Counter(old_failures), Counter(new_failures)
        provenance = _Power10_SourceProvenance(baseline, current, part, new_text)
        rows.append({'part': part, 'input_revision_identical': True, 'analyzer': warning_rows,
            'power10_existing_items': list((new_count & old_count).elements()),
            'power10_new_or_changed_items': list((new_count - old_count).elements()),
            'power10_baseline_only_items': list((old_count - new_count).elements()),
            'source_line_provenance': provenance,
            'unmapped_failure_locations': [row for row in provenance if row['classification'] != 'VERBATIM_BASELINE_LINE'],
            'overlong_function_line_changes': [{'function': name, 'baseline_lines': old_lengths[name],
                'current_lines': count, 'acceptance': 'FAIL_REMAINS_NO_EXCEPTION_GRANTED'}
                for name, count in new_lengths.items() if name in old_lengths and count != old_lengths[name]],
            'qualification': 'Text multiplicity is not source ownership: removed old and added new identical directives can cancel. Inspect source_line_provenance/unmapped locations and modified function bodies. Equal lines do not prove semantics; no baseline exception is granted.',
            'acceptance': 'FAIL / CRITICAL_CONTRACTS_NOT_PROVEN'})
    (current/'baseline-attribution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'baseline': str(baseline), 'rows': rows}, indent=2))

        record = {"label": label, "command": command, "cwd": str(cwd),
                  "started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "expected_exit": expected}
        log = output / (label + ".log")
        with log.open("w", encoding="utf8") as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=900)
        record.update(exit=result.returncode, log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      finished_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        records.append(record)
        (output / "commands.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
        print(label, result.returncode, flush=True)
        if expected is not None and result.returncode != expected:
            print(log.read_text(encoding="utf8")[-16000:], flush=True)
            raise RuntimeError("validation failed: " + label)
        return log.read_text(encoding="utf8")
